metadata.description: Sector of employment and earnings of Irish graduates 1 to 10 years after graduation, by field and institution. Each horizon pools all graduating cohorts the CSO has published for it.

method.pooling: Each years-since-graduation value pools all published graduating cohorts for that horizon; Year 1 and Year 10 are different cohorts.
method.earnings: Unweighted average of cohort P50 (median) weekly earnings, nominal euro; annual equivalent = weekly x 52.
method.population: Young graduates in substantial employment in Ireland only (CSO definition); graduates working abroad are not included.
method.institutions: Institution values are never filled in from national figures; the national benchmark for an institution is averaged over the same cohorts.

institutions.RC: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland (RCSI)
institutions.AD: National College of Art and Design (NCAD)
